items.title: Clem Raymond Interview, 1958-08-25
items.q: Willie Umphrey? Willie Umphrey? Yeah, his name Willie Umphrey Jr. I suppose, yeah. Younger's father. Well, I don't know of him, see.

ctx.x: He's in a wheelchair now. Can you imagine that? We'll go around and take care of him, but he looks well, he looks healthy and big and strong, and his legs are gone. He's seven and nine now.

Old man Jim? No, Willie. What is his father? Willie Umphrey? Willie Umphrey? Yeah, his name Willie Umphrey Jr. I suppose, yeah. Younger's father. Well, I don't know of him, see. I didn't know, I thought it was his father.
No? No, I saw him last spring sometime. 79. What did Mr. Umphrey teach you? Did he keep on with the same book, or did he have you doing the other things?
